title: 第6章 亵渎第7章 枷锁第8章 龙晶
lines: 星尘之心饱含怨恨的咆哮，如同亿万冰针贯穿卡拉斯残存的意识。
星辰被撕裂、被矮人亵渎的痛苦画面，带着冰冷的绝望和疯狂的冲击，在他脑海中掀起毁灭风暴！
他蜷缩在流淌幽绿光芒的碎石上，身体因灵魂剧痛而抽搐，口鼻溢出带着星光的血沫。
“轰隆隆——！
整个矿坑发出垂死呻吟！
山体结构在庞大意志的挣扎下开始崩解！
巨大裂缝如黑色闪电爬满坑道，无数吨岩层错位倾塌！
幽绿光芒从裂缝中喷涌，将崩塌景象染上地狱色彩！
暗爪的咆哮压过山崩地裂！
它覆盖崭新鳞片的身躯在震动中矗立如磐石！
熔金竖瞳倒映着星辰被亵渎的画面，血脉深处的暴怒被彻底点燃！
它不再是单纯的幼龙愤怒，而是融合了星辰古老怨恨的纯粹毁灭意志！
覆盖星图纹路的翅膀张到极限，翼膜上幽绿纹路如活物般燃烧！
对着矿脉核心的方向，对着束缚星辰亿万年的“石之囚笼”
，它发出终结的咆哮！
卡拉斯在剧痛中，只看见暗爪在幽绿光芒和崩落巨石映衬下的黑色背影，正对着矿坑深处张开布满獠牙的巨口！
喉咙深处凝聚起一团狂暴旋转的毁灭能量——核心漆黑如墨，边缘跳跃着无数幽绿星火！
那能量让周围坠落的巨石都在半空中扭曲软化！
跑！
必须离开！
求生本能如同最后火星，在灵魂撕裂和山体崩塌的双重绝境中点燃！
卡拉斯不知哪来的力气，猛地从碎石堆中弹起，不顾伤口撕裂的剧痛，不顾口鼻溢出的血沫，如同被死亡追赶的野兽，踉跄着扑向暗爪身后相对开阔的坑道！
暗影与星火交织的毁灭龙息，如同挣脱地狱枷锁的狂龙，从暗爪口中喷薄而出！
一道更加凝聚、狂暴的光柱，带着撕裂空间的尖啸，狠狠撞向前方堵塞坑道的巨大落石！
被光柱核心命中的岩石瞬间消失！
边缘被幽绿星火舔舐的岩层飞速熔融汽化，化为流淌的暗红岩浆！
一个巨大通道被硬生生熔穿出来！
通道尽头豁然开朗，隐约可见超乎想象的地下空间！
然而，就在毁灭龙息喷吐的瞬间，异变陡生！
暗爪覆盖星尘鳞片的身躯剧烈震颤！
熔金竖瞳中的毁灭暴怒瞬间被巨大的痛苦和惊愕取代！
content_en:
Stardust Heart's roar filled with resentment was like billions of ice needles piercing Karas's remaining consciousness.
The painful images of stars being torn apart and desecrated by dwarves, with cold despair and crazy impact, set off a storm of destruction in his mind!
He curled up on the gravel flowing with green light, his body twitching due to the severe pain in his soul, and blood foam with starlight overflowed from his mouth and nose.
“Rumble—!
! "
The whole mine let out a dying groan!
The mountain structure began to disintegrate under the struggle of the huge will!
Huge cracks filled the tunnel like black lightning, and countless tons of rock formations collapsed!
Green light spurted out from the cracks, dyeing the collapsed scene the color of hell!
"Ho-Ang-!"
! "
The roar of Darkclaw overwhelmed the landslides and cracks in the earth!
Its body covered with brand new scales stood like a rock in the vibration!
The molten gold vertical pupils reflected the scene of stars being desecrated, and the rage deep in the blood was completely ignited!
It is no longer the pure anger of the young dragon, but the pure will to destroy combined with the ancient resentment of the stars!
The wings covered with star pattern patterns were stretched to the limit, and the dark green patterns on the wing membranes burned like living creatures!
Facing the direction of the core of the mineral vein, facing the "stone cage" that has bound the stars for hundreds of millions of years
, it roars to an end!
In the severe pain, Karas could only see Dark Claw's black back against the green light and the falling boulders, facing the depths of the mine with its huge mouth full of fangs!
A ball of violently rotating destructive energy condensed deep in the throat - the core was as black as ink, with countless green sparks jumping around the edges!
That energy caused the falling boulders around to twist and soften in mid-air!
run!
Must leave!
The survival instinct is like the last spark, ignited in the double desperate situation of soul tearing and mountain collapse!
Karas got the strength from nowhere and suddenly jumped up from the rubble. Ignoring the severe pain of the tearing wound and the blood flowing from his mouth and nose, he staggered towards the relatively open tunnel behind Dark Claw like a beast being chased by death!
“Boom——!
! "
The dragon's breath of destruction intertwined with shadow and sparks, like a mad dragon breaking free from the shackles of hell, spurts out from the mouth of the dark claw!
A more concentrated and violent beam of light, with a scream that tore apart the space, slammed into the huge rockfall blocking the tunnel ahead!
The rock hit by the core of the light pillar disappeared instantly!
The rock formations licked by the green sparks at the edges quickly melted and vaporized, turning into flowing dark red magma!
A huge passage was forcibly melted through!
The end of the passage suddenly opens up, and you can vaguely see the underground space beyond imagination!
However, at the moment when the Destruction Dragon breathed out, a sudden change occurred!
Dark Claw's body covered with stardust scales trembled violently!
The destructive rage in the molten gold vertical pupils was instantly replaced by tremendous pain and consternation!
